entries.label: EMG RMS amplitude
entries.description: Mean RMS of the EMG signal during the active phase of the repetitions of a session.
entries.notes: Depends on electrode placement and skin: compare through %MVC when possible.

entries.label: EMG RMS as % of MVC
entries.description: emg rms_mv divided by the MVC reference of the same muscle. Makes sessions and days comparable.

entries.label: EMG peak as % of MVC
entries.description: Highest windowed RMS reached during the session, as % of MVC.

entries.label: EMG median frequency
entries.description: Median frequency of the power spectral density of the active phase. Needs the raw signal.

entries.label: EMG median frequency slope
entries.description: Slope of the median frequency across the repetitions of a session (fatigue trend). Needs the raw signal.

entries.label: EMG resting RMS
entries.description: RMS with the muscle relaxed (noise floor and electrode contact check).

entries.label: Left-right EMG asymmetry
entries.description: Relative difference between left and right %MVC of the same muscle.
entries.notes: Needs one EMG channel per side.

entries.label: Spine elongation
entries.description: Mean cord length minus the calibrated rest length, in a passive spine_check session.
entries.notes: Cord response is non-linear and recovers slowly (1-2 min): measure after the recovery wait.

entries.label: Spine elongation, relative
entries.description: Elongation as a percentage of the calibrated rest length.

entries.label: Peak spine elongation in exercise
entries.description: Maximum elongation reached during the repetitions of an exercise session.

entries.label: Spine length range in exercise
entries.description: Maximum minus minimum length during the repetitions.

entries.label: Length recovery time
entries.description: Time after the exercise for the length to return within tolerance of the pre-exercise value. Mixes the cord's own hysteresis with tissue behaviour.

entries.label: Cord resting resistance
entries.description: Resistance at rest, to detect drift of the cord or its clamps between sessions.

entries.label: Range of motion
entries.description: Angular range covered in the plane during a repetition (integrated gyroscope, mean over repetitions). Does not rely on gravity, so it is valid in microgravity.

entries.label: Peak angular velocity
entries.description: Highest angular speed in the plane during the repetitions.

entries.label: Acceleration RMS
entries.description: RMS of the dynamic acceleration magnitude (static component removed). In microgravity the gravity component is absent, so compare across environments with care.

entries.label: Repetitions completed
entries.description: Repetitions detected or marked in an exercise session.

entries.label: Mean repetition duration
entries.description: Mean time from rep_start to rep_end.

entries.label: Repetition duration variability
entries.description: Coefficient of variation of the repetition duration; low values mean a well standardised execution.
entries.notes: Quality gate for comparing sessions, not a health indicator.

entries.label: Pain, 7-day mean
entries.description: Mean of the daily pain NRS over the last 7 days.

entries.label: Stiffness, 7-day mean
entries.description: Mean of the daily stiffness NRS over the last 7 days.

entries.label: Sleep, 7-day mean
entries.description: Mean reported sleep hours over the last 7 days.

entries.label: Red flag reports, 7 days
entries.description: Number of reports with at least one red flag in the last 7 days. Any red flag escalates regardless of this count.
